senses.gloss: लप् [cf. Gk. ὀ-λοϕ-ύρομαι ; perhaps Lat. lāmentum for lap-mentum.]
2. लप् (ifc.) speaking, uttering (see अभिलापलप्).
लपन n. the mouth, Śiś.
speaking, talking, W.
लपित mfn. chattered, spoken, said, L.
लपित॑ (˚त॑), n. chatter, hum, AV.
लपिता f. N. of a Śārṅgikā (a kind of bird) with which Mandapāla is said to have allied himself, MBh.
लाप m. speaking, talking, W.
लाप लापिन्. See p. 896, col. 2.
लापिका See अन्तर्- and बहिर्-ल्˚.
लापिन् mfn. (ifc.) speaking, uttering, Hariv.
wailing, lamenting, MārkP.
लापिनिका f. (prob.) talk, conversation, Siṃhās.
लाप्य mfn. to be spoken &c., Pāṇ. iii, 1, 126.
लाप्य See p. 896, col. 2.
लपेटिका f. N. of a place of pilgrimage, MBh.
लपेत m. N. of a demon presiding over a partic. disease of children, PārGṛ.
लप्सिका f. N. of a kind of prepared food, Bhpr.
लप्सुद n. = कूर्च, the beard (of a goat &c.), KātyŚr., Sch.
लप्सुदिन् mfn. having a beard, bearded (said of a goat), TS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
ला॑पु m. or n. a partic. instrument, MaitrS.
